create_motor_limits: create a MotorLimits instance with custom angle velocity and torque bounds for a robot joint
use_motor_control_mode: use the MotorControlMode enum to select POSITION TORQUE HYBRID or PWM control for a robot motor
use_wheeled_robot_control_mode: use the WheeledRobotControlMode enum to select BASE ARM or ALL control for a wheeled robot
create_twist_action_limits: create a TwistActionLimits dataclass with max and min linear and angular velocity bounds
use_hybrid_action_index: use the HybridActionIndex enum to access POSITION VELOCITY or TORQUE components of a hybrid action tuple
